categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 本批论文聚焦数据高效微调、Agent自我改进与跨组织信任，以及模型评测与安全归因的有效性。

articles.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
articles.zh: Ambient LLM：通过温度匹配实现数据高效的有监督微调
articles.summary: 如果你手上标注数据少又想微调出可用模型，这篇讲的是靠匹配输出温度分布来省数据，值得先验证它在你的任务上是否真成立
articles.author: Giannis Daras, Marios Papachristou 等
articles.body: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
articles.bodyZh: 想给自回归语言模型（autoregressive language models）收集大规模、多样化、高质量的后训练数据集（post-training datasets），确实很难。所以，监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning，SFT）通常只能拿比预训练小得多的数据集来做，这就容易过拟合（overfitting），还会把数据分布尾部（tails of the data distribution）那部分知识灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）掉。为了防止模型这样“崩掉”，我们提出了 Ambient SFT（环境式监督微调），这是一个有理论依据的框架，思路是用不完美的预测来扩充微调数据集。具体来说，我们拿一个“冻结”的预训练模型（pre-trained model）当带噪声的老师，要求微调后的模型在粗粒度上跟它对上。更具体地说，后训练模型给出的条件分布（conditional distributions）在“高温”平滑之后，要和预训练模型对应的条件分布高温版本（high-temperature versions）对齐。温度这个超参数（temperature hyperparameter）控制我们对预训练模型的信任程度：当 T→∞ 时，就退回普通 SFT；当 T=1 时，就变成知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）。我们证明了，在领域适配（domain adaptation）、指令微调（instruction-tuning）和推理（reasoning）上，这个方法都优于标准 SFT，平均相对提升最高能到 21%。

articles.title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
articles.zh: StringQFT：面向AI辅助理论物理的多用途教材资源
articles.summary: 如果你在做AI辅助科研，或者想给模型喂高质量物理语料，这个教材级资源可以直接当训练和评测素材
articles.author: Xingyang Yu
articles.body: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.
articles.bodyZh: 我们推出 StringQFT，它既是一套讲弦论怎么构造量子场论（quantum field theory）的教材合集，也是给 AI 辅助理论物理（AI-assisted theoretical physics）研究打底的基础设施。这套合集一共 18 卷、190 章、3795 页，内容覆盖膜探针（brane probes）、膜网（brane webs）、几何工程（geometric engineering）、F 理论构造（F-theory constructions）、包裹 M5 膜（wrapped M5-branes）以及精确世界面构造（exact worldsheet constructions）。它附带的开放基准清单（open-book benchmark inventory）收录了 1073 道题，其中 499 道能自动做有限答案检查。面向检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation），它提供了 1371 条章节记录，都链接到教材来源和 PDF 位置，还配了一个本地词法检索器（lexical retriever）。训练数据准备方面，用 21 个私有的、带来源链接的示例做了演示。面向智能体（agents），它开放了 19 个计算工具，每个工具都明确了输入和有限取值域，把工具使用和教材推导串了起来。我们用具体问题、检索到的段落和有限计算来展示这些用法。这套教材合集和配套资源可在 https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT 获取。

articles.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
articles.zh: LLM Agent 还需要被"教"怎么自我改进吗？
articles.summary: 如果你正在给Agent设计自我反思、自我修正的流程，这篇会告诉你，那些精心写的提示词可能没你想的那么必要
articles.author: Shobhita Sundaram, Cansu Sancaktar 等
articles.body: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）越来越能自己推动学习了。所谓自我提升方法（self-improvement methods），就是把模型优化里的不少环节交给模型自己去做。模型越强，就越会引出一个很基本的问题：这些越来越强的模型，还需要我们告诉它“该怎么自我提升”吗？这篇论文研究了一种自主范式：只要给智能体一些基础组件（primitives）、资源和一个大方向的自我提升目标，它就会自己搭建一套基于上下文的优化（context-based optimization）算法，用来做自我学习。作者拿游戏当试验场：给一个参数冻结的大语言模型智能体（frozen LLM agent）一定的算力预算（compute budget），再给它收集经验、更新文本文档的工具，让它自由试错，既没有外部设定好的循环流程，也不能接触真实世界数据。结果发现，能力足够强的模型在这种条件下确实能自我提升，而且它们用出来的策略，和经典的自我调节学习（self-regulated learning）认知框架、以及机器学习文献里“自生成课程”（self-generated curricula）的概念能对得上。论文还进一步研究了：学到的文本成果能不能迁移到外部基准测试（external benchmarks）上，结果发现，在不同游戏时间跨度、游戏机制和3D导航（3D navigation）任务上，都能看到提升。

articles.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
articles.zh: Bias Head 到底测的是什么？头部级偏见归因中的不可识别性
articles.summary: 如果你正拿"某个注意力头负责偏见"这类结论写论文或做审核，这篇提醒你这种归因在方法上可能根本没法唯一确定
articles.author: S. M Seefat Alam
articles.body: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.
articles.bodyZh: 这类方法把大语言模型里的社会偏见定位到单个注意力头（attention head）上，再通过消融（ablation）把它去掉；它们只靠公平性指标（fairness metric）上的效果来证明自己有用，却从来没拿出证据说明：用来挑这些注意力头的统计量（statistic）真的在衡量偏见。我们拿 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 复核了这件事。在两个模型上，这张注意力头图谱和一个不看标签、只看回复长度的图谱（label-blind response-length map）相关性分别达到 ρ=-0.950 和 -0.768，看上去像是在指认一个表层混杂因素（surface confound）。但我们做了一个打破“长度—标签”耦合的干预，结果否定了这种读法：把提示词（prompt）固定住以后，回复长度只能解释这个统计量方差的 1%。真正能解释它的是提示词身份（prompt identity），能解释 64% 的方差；而且这个排序并不是随长度单调变化的。在任何一个固定提示词里，公平标签、回复长度、以及有没有出现受保护群体词元（protected-group token），这三者都高度共线（collinear），φ=0.95；这有一部分是标签规则本身定义出来的。所以任何观察性分析（observational analysis）都没法把这张图谱归因到其中任何一个因素；这一路方法里，也没有谁真的做了能做出这种归因的实验。那些更实质的主张也各自站不住：不管用哪种参照解读（reference reading），在两个模型上，偏见选择性（bias selectivity）都没有集中在后层（late-layer-concentrated）；而且我们测试过的注意力头集合（head set），消融以后没有一个能降低不公平率（unfairness rate）。反倒是它的补集（complement），用相反标签来打分，能稳定地把模型的拒绝行为（refusal behaviour）打掉（p=2.7×10^{-5}），这说明这套流程（pipeline）在这个量级上确实能检测到效果。

articles.title: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
articles.zh: 得分更高的代码模型，并没有干更多的活
articles.summary: 如果你在按benchmark分数选代码模型，这篇文章用实际任务完成度告诉你，榜单涨分和真正把活干完是两回事
articles.author: Yining Hua
articles.body: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026, a U.S. export control directive banned access to Claude Fable 5 for 19 days, which forced users to switch to other models. During this time, most former Fable 5 users switched to Opus 4.8 (11 points lower on SWE-Bench Pro compared to Fable 5). We treat this suspension as a natural experiment, where the people and projects stayed the same and only the model changed, so we could isolate the effect of Fable 5 on user productivity. We tracked GitHub pull requests of 297 Fable 5 users before, during, and after the suspension. We used 8,908 developers who stayed on Opus 4.8 all the time as the control group. We also repeated the comparison across five model upgrades before and after the suspension in 2026 (1,208 developers, 15,442 pull requests). Fitting a difference-in-differences model with developer and date fixed effects, we found that having access to Fable 5 increased the 7-day merge rate of pull requests by only 1.4 percentage points [-1.4; +4.3], which was not statistically significant. Similarly, no significant increases of merge rates were found with the upgrades (weighted mean: -0.9 percentage points [-1.9; +0.2]); all five estimates were negative (95% intervals included 0, did not differ from each other). We also did not observe a significant increase in the number of pull requests merged per week (+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]).
articles.bodyZh: 新的编程模型总爱拿编程基准测试上的分数提升来打广告。但还没有研究验证过：在这些基准上分数更高的模型，是不是真能完成更多实际工作。2026年6月12日，美国一项出口管制指令禁止访问 Claude Fable 5，持续了19天，用户被迫改用其他模型。这段时间里，大多数原来用 Fable 5 的用户转到了 Opus 4.8（在 SWE-Bench Pro 上比 Fable 5 低11分）。我们把这次停用当成一次自然实验（natural experiment）：人和项目都没变，只有模型变了，这样就能单独看出 Fable 5 对用户生产力的影响。我们追踪了297名 Fable 5 用户在停用前、停用期间和停用后的 GitHub 拉取请求（pull requests）。我们把一直使用 Opus 4.8 的8,908名开发者作为对照组。我们还在2026年停用前后发生的五次模型升级中重复了对比（1,208名开发者，15,442个拉取请求）。用开发者和日期固定效应（fixed effects）拟合双重差分模型（difference-in-differences model）后，我们发现：能用 Fable 5 只让拉取请求的7天合并率（merge rate）提高了1.4个百分点[-1.4; +4.3]，统计上并不显著。同样，模型升级也没有带来显著的合并率提升（加权平均：-0.9个百分点[-1.9; +0.2]）；五次估计全是负的（95%区间都包含0，彼此之间也没有差别）。我们也没看到每周合并的拉取请求数量有显著增加（+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]）。

articles.title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
articles.zh: 读取场景状态：揭示视觉语言模型中的安全失效
articles.summary: 如果你在做VLM落地的安全评估，这篇从场景状态理解的角度挖出了被忽略的失效模式，值得纳入你的测试集
articles.author: Tongxi Wu, Yuyang Cheng 等
articles.body: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.
articles.bodyZh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）能通过解读画面里发生的事，给出有害帮助，哪怕用户没有明说要干坏事。我们把这叫作“场景状态安全漏洞”（scene-state safety vulnerability），并推出 SceneSafetyBench：包含375组图文问答，覆盖初始、中间、最终三种场景状态，以及五种视觉呈现方式。拿八个VLM来测，这类场景状态输入能诱出有害协助，攻击成功率（ASRs）在45.6%到72.3%之间。对三个VLM做对比分析发现，场景状态输入在逐层安全相关信号特征上最像二维码相关图片，但后层平均读数更低，生成过程中的信号动态也不一样。为了把这种漏洞变成一套系统化攻击，我们提出 S3TA：把有害目标转成场景状态，分别查询图文问答对，再把回答拼起来。在八个开源权重和商用VLM上，跨 MM-SafetyBench 的七个类别，S3TA 的模型平均攻击成功率达到71.2%，比最强基线高6.1个百分点。文本侧过滤和视觉审核能提供的保护有限。这些发现说明，不能只筛查输入内容，还得守住模型通过“基于场景的推理”推断出来的那些协助。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
articles.zh: 在笔记本核显上用SFT与QLoRA微调Gemma 4边缘模型生成MATLAB信号处理代码
articles.summary: 如果你没有GPU预算却想微调一个垂直领域代码模型，这篇给了一条在笔记本上就能跑通的最小可行路径
articles.author: Mehmet Altan Toksöz
articles.body: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.
articles.bodyZh: 能在笔记本上跑的小语言模型，用来离线写信号处理代码挺有吸引力，但它们在数字信号处理（DSP）的一些约定上会犯系统性错误。我们拿 66 个经过校验的样例，覆盖 11 个信号处理 MATLAB 子任务，对 Gemma 4 边缘模型 E2B 和 E4B 做监督微调（SFT）：在笔记本的集成显卡（iGPU）上用低秩适配（LoRA）和量化低秩适配（QLoRA），再通过 OpenVINO 把带适配器（adapter）的 8 位整数（int8）模型部署起来。在留出的变体上，用确定性检查器打分，E2B 的通过率从 18/66 升到 37/66（LoRA）和 37/66（QLoRA），E4B 从 32/66 升到 47/66（QLoRA）。把 159 个失败程序都读了一遍后发现，适配器能消掉大多数“约定类”错误，比如滞后（lag）的正负号、单位和数组形状，但对构造信号和噪声这类错误基本没什么帮助。放到运行时用，适配器会让生成速度掉 17% 到 19%。

articles.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
articles.zh: Agent信任基础设施（ATI）：面向跨组织自主AI Agent的联邦身份、信任、认证与问责架构
articles.summary: 如果你在考虑不同组织的Agent互相调用接口，这篇给了一套身份与追责的架构思路，但落地难点在于谁来当那个"联邦中心"
articles.author: Viet K. Nguyen, Mohammad I. Husain
articles.body: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.
articles.bodyZh: AI 智能体（AI agents）越来越多地跨组织边界协作，会调用工具，也会跟独立机构运营的智能体打交道。现有智能体框架虽然支持规划和协调，但缺少一套通用机制，来核实跨组织场景下的智能体身份、执行完整性和授权情况。为此，我们提出“智能体信任基础设施”（Agent Trust Infrastructure，ATI）：这是一个不依赖特定框架的安全架构，建立在公钥基础设施（PKI）、零信任架构（ZTA）和远程证明（remote attestation）之上。ATI 通过同级的组织证书颁发机构（AgentCAs）建立联邦信任，不需要一个共享的根权威。在执行请求之前，ATI 会验证智能体证书，核查已批准的模型、工具和系统提示词（system-prompt）配置，并通过三道策略检查来落实授权。我们把 ATI 做成一个外部安全执行层，能跟现有智能体框架集成，不用改它们底层模型。我们在一个模拟的八组织联邦里评估 ATI，用了六种智能体框架，每个框架部署一个五智能体团队。安全实验涉及两个组织，评估 14 种攻击场景和六项良性任务，覆盖五种智能体模型，每种攻击用五种变体、每个变体重复三次。实验结果由一组评委模型来评判。把所有执行机制都打开后，攻击遏制率从 43% 提高到 84%（在全部配置下都一致评估的 11 种攻击场景中，从 40% 提高到 80%），而执行机制带来的开销大约是每个请求 174 微秒。ATI 以开源、不依赖框架的软件包形式发布，使用 IETF WIMSE 工作负载令牌格式（workload token formats）做身份和请求验证，使用实体证明令牌（Entity Attestation Tokens）做模型、工具和系统提示词的完整性验证。
